title: Meet Hip-Hop’s Buzziest New Acts in Billboard’s ‘Trending Up’ Series
summary: Meet the new wave of artists pushing it to the center of every hip-hop conversation
body: Hip-Hop is hitting a different kind of stride right now in our latest installment of Billboard News’ Trending Up , presented by Sonesta International Hotels, and we’re here to help you say you heard about them first. Luh Tyler and Molly Santana are making a splash in the hip-hop space with fresh new energy, and we want you to get to know them before everyone else catches on. If you’re feeling the vibes of Luh Tyler, make sure you catch him in Mesa, Arizona on August 23rd. The show will be just a short drive away from Sonesta Suites Scottsdale Gainey Ranch. The 164-all suite retreat features amenities like full kitchens, an outdoor swimming pool, hot tub, and fitness center. Sonesta Suites Scottsdale Gainey Ranch Separately, if you’re into the sounds of Molly Santana, you can catch her in Los Angeles, CA on August 27th. Pair the concert with a stay at the Sonesta Redondo Beach and Marina, where you’ll be able to enjoy ocean views, a heated swimming pool, and multiple dining options. title: Ariana Grande Posts Photos Featuring Ricky Alvarez After Rumors of Rekindled Romance
summary: "Wrote some songs about Ricky/ We always find our way back," the star recently sang.
body: Ariana Grande fueled speculation that she’s rekindled her romance with Ricky Alvarez after posting a pair of selfies to an Instagram carousel post on Wednesday (Aug. 12) that show Ari and her former backup dancer cuddled up. However, the star did tag the dancer in the snap. Another photo had social media in a frenzy, featuring Alvarez and Ari taking a blurry mirror selfie, which was flipped upside down. Again, the singer-actress tagged the dancer. The Arianators took the subtle pictures as the Grammy-winning singer confirming her rumored relationship and going “Instagram official.” Billboard has reached out to Grande’s reps for comment. title: Highly rated Anker Prime 3-in-1 foldable Qi2.2 charger gets a 34% price drop
summary: Anker’s Prime 3-in-1 Foldable Charger drops to $99.74, a 34% discount, with 25W Qi2.2 charging and a travel-ready design.
body: The Anker Prime 3-in-1 Foldable Charger is built for people who want one compact charger for their everyday gear, and there’s a solid deal on it at Amazon right now. This palm-sized charging station folds into a small block for travel, then opens into a stand-style setup that works well on a desk, nightstand, or in a hotel room. See the deal at Amazon
